inspiration.observed_pattern: A recursive CTE walks parent links upward while resolving each item name through two optional metadata tables and a fallback expression, then orders the path from root to leaf before concatenating names with a separator.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Minimized to one folder, one metadata-free intermediate asset, and one file leaf while retaining the recursive parent walk, two optional metadata joins, COALESCE fallback, ordered GROUP_CONCAT, and deterministic separator.

fixture_notes: The minimized leaf resolves through a folder name, an asset-ID fallback, and a file name.
determinism_notes: Integer asset IDs, parent links, metadata names, recursion depth, and aggregate ordering are fixed. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE mini_cached_assets (asset_id INT PRIMARY KEY, parent_id INT NULL, asset_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE mini_cached_file_meta (asset_id INT PRIMARY KEY, file_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE mini_cached_folder_meta (asset_id INT PRIMARY KEY, folder_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: WITH RECURSIVE asset_path (asset_id, asset_name, parent_id, depth) AS (SELECT a.asset_id, COALESCE(f.file_name, d.folder_name, CONCAT('asset-', a.asset_id)), a.parent_id, 0 FROM mini_cached_assets a LEFT JOIN mini_cached_file_meta f ON a.asset_id = f.asset_id LEFT JOIN mini_cached_folder_meta d ON a.asset_id = d.asset_id WHERE a.asset_id = 13 UNION ALL SELECT a.asset_id, COALESCE(f.file_name, d.folder_name, CONCAT('asset-', a.asset_id)), a.parent_id, p.depth + 1 FROM mini_cached_assets a INNER JOIN asset_path p ON a.asset_id = p.parent_id LEFT JOIN mini_cached_file_meta f ON a.asset_id = f.asset_id LEFT JOIN mini_cached_folder_meta d ON a.asset_id = d.asset_id), ordered_path AS (SELECT asset_name, depth FROM asset_path WHERE asset_name <> '') SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE GROUP_CONCAT(asset_name ORDER BY depth DESC SEPARATOR '/') END AS full_path FROM ordered_path

checks.sql: SELECT asset_id, parent_id FROM mini_cached_assets ORDER BY asset_id
